events.title: The ban on Runescape discussions has been lifted; a Runescape sub-forum was reopened with new rules.
A forum rules compilation page was created listing all forum-specific rules.
Off-Marketplace buy/sell/trade threads now result in a ban
events.description: Creating threads involving buying/selling/trading outside the Marketplace will now result in a ban; a new 'Not In Marketplace' report option was added.

events.title: Post Activity link added to profiles for l33ts and ub3rs
events.description: A Post Activity link was added to each member's profile, letting l33ts and ub3rs see how many posts a member has in individual sections.

events.title: A Hackintosh Help sub-forum was added under Apple Mac and OS X for setup help and build guides.
A Partnerships, Hiring, and Personnel sub-forum was added under Service Offerings.
New Virtual Game Items section added under Marketplace
events.description: A new Virtual Game Items section was added under the Marketplace for selling Runescape gold, WoW equipment, and similar items; account trading is not allowed there.

events.title: Rusty_v's account compromised; he is demoted from Staff to Mentor
events.description: Rusty_v's account was compromised; the attacker repfucked 3 members, removed many reps, and swapped Liberty Reserve payment links to their own LR ID. He was also demoted from Staff to Mentor with no public reason given.

events.title: Omniscient publishes current country-block list
events.description: Omniscient published a list of currently country-blocked countries; the list is not permanent and is subject to change.

events.title: Scooter crosses 1,000 reputation; тнєJσкєя nears second place
events.description: Scooter crossed 1,000 reputation, joining the top members; тнєJσкєя is climbing toward second place behind Omniscient.

events.title: Vitani's Mate reaches 20,000 posts in nine months
events.description: Vitani's Mate reached 20,000 posts in nine months at over 85 posts per day, less than 2,000 from first place in highest post count.

events.title: SeaNanners's sushi-award video exposed as leeched footage
events.description: SeaNanners™'s 'first time eating sushi' video, posted to win the Sushi Lovers award, was revealed by Defcon. to be a lie with leeched footage.

events.title: Anime Adventures launched AARadio, a member-run radio station headed by Tasemu.
Members warn community about Avante's hosting service
events.description: Members posted threads warning about Avante's hosting; Poliice published a warning thread alongside Avante's main hosting thread.
